Marissa — thanks for the context and the recommendation. I’m supportive of approving a procurement exception but with the following constraints: 

1) Discount cap: approve up to 15% (one-time or applied to first-year ACV) — 20% feels out of band given our discounting thresholds for new Enterprise bookings.
2) SLA: agree to offer custom SLA 99.9% but modify credits structure to align with our standard policy (we can do a softer credit ladder, not full revenue offset).
3) Condition: must receive SOC 2 Type II and a security review sign-off from Security (please loop in Security for the attestation).

Aditya — please prepare a redlined quote reflecting 15% discount and the proposed SLA language (I’ll review legal exposure once redline is available). If legal pushes back, escalate to me immediately.
